reader_summary.overview: with Lisa Hawke (@ldhawke) and Steven Sinofsky (@stevesi) Given concern around data breaches. Though it originated in Europe, GDPR is a form of long-arm jurisdiction that affects many U.S. companies -- including most software startups, because data collection and user privacy touch so much of what they do.

key_points.text: with Lisa Hawke (@ldhawke) and Steven Sinofsky (@stevesi) Given concern around data breaches.
With EU regulators focusing most on transparency, GDPR affects everything from user interface design to engineering to legal contracts and more.
That's why it's really about "privacy by design", argues former environmental scientist and lawyer Lisa Hawke.
